title: Motor Coordination in Space: An Analysis of the Effects of Microgravity on XRCCI DNA Repair Protein Function
protocol: Culture immature mammalian cerebellar interneurons with a sufficient nutrient medium.
Maintain the culture at 23°C.
Split the interneurons into four groups for different conditions.
Expose one group to UV radiation and microgravity on the ISS.
Expose another group to UV radiation but no microgravity on Earth.
Subject a third group to only microgravity on the ISS without UV radiation.
Keep a control group neither exposed to UV radiation nor microgravity on Earth.
Measure the magnitude of UV irradiation on the ISS in J/m².
Replicate the measured UV irradiation magnitude for all samples on Earth.
Calculate Sample Ct’s (threshold number of cycles) for each condition.
Determine average Ct’s for each condition.
Compute ΔCt values by comparing avg Ct’s to the control condition.
Calculate ΔΔCt values by finding the difference between each condition’s ΔCt and control ΔCt.
Assess 2-ΔΔCt (fold relationship) for statistical analysis.
Conduct null hypothesis t-tests with a p-value threshold of 0.05 to assess significance.
Centrifuge the interneurons after exposure to their respective conditions.
Disrupt the centrifuged interneurons with Buffer RLT Plus.
Homogenize the disrupted samples via Bead Mill.
Lysate and purify the homogenized samples using the DNeasy Plus Mini Kit.
Assess the quality and quantity of extracted DNA using a NanoDrop 2000.
Expose DNA samples to RNase and protease for further purification if needed.
Amplify the MAP2 gene with PCR using Taq polymerase.
Quantify the DNA products using the iTaq™ Universal SYBR® Green One-Step Kit.
